sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: {CLIENT} wants a {PERCENT} discount for a three-year commitment.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Huh, {PERCENT} is more than I expected.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: That's steeper than anything we've given this year.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: But a three-year term is worth a lot to us.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We offer half of what they asked, and only with the three-year term.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: I can support that.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Their discount ask is way above our usual.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: They're asking for {PERCENT} off in exchange for committing to three years.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: {PERCENT}, really?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Which honestly is attractive.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Then our counter is half the discount they want, tied to the three-year term.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Okay.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Fair.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Who presents to the {CLIENT} board?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: I know their CFO best.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: But they asked specifically for someone who can answer security questions.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Let's have {S2} lead and {S3} join for the security part.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Good, I'd like the backup.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Their board wants someone in the room who can handle security questions.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: I still think I should lead, since I know the CFO.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Agreed, {S2} leads the presentation, and {S3} covers security.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Works for me.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: The pilot with {CLIENT} ended with eleven active users out of the forty seats.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: That's not a great signal.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Their champion left halfway through, to be fair.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We'll extend the pilot by one month with a new champion before deciding on the full deal.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: That's reasonable.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Before we judge the pilot, remember their champion left in the middle of it.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Still, only eleven of the forty seats were active at the end.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Let's give it one more month with a new champion, then make the call on the full deal.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Okay.
